alerts.name: Table Idle Too Long
alerts.description: A table has been occupied with no staff interaction for longer than the threshold. Guests may be waiting for service, the bill, or clearing.
alerts.trigger: Zone state = IDLE AND duration > 8 minutes AND zone type = dining

alerts.name: Dirty Table Not Cleared
alerts.description: Guests have left and the table has not been cleared or reset. Blocks seating new guests and increases wait-to-seat time.
alerts.trigger: Zone state = DIRTY AND duration > 4 minutes AND zone type = dining

alerts.name: Entry Queue Building
alerts.description: Multiple guests are standing in the entry/waiting area. Indicates seating bottleneck or host absence.
alerts.trigger: Zone state = QUEUE AND duration > 2 minutes AND standing count >= 3 AND zone type = entry

alerts.name: Table Waiting for Service
alerts.description: An occupied table has not had any staff presence in the zone for an extended period. Guests may feel neglected.
alerts.trigger: Zone state = OCCUPIED AND seconds since staff visit > 6 minutes AND zone type = dining

alerts.name: Zone Overload
alerts.description: A dining zone has high occupancy AND there is a queue at entry. Indicates the restaurant is at capacity and needs active management.
alerts.trigger: Occupancy ratio >= 80% AND queue detected in entry zone AND zone type = dining

alerts.name: Excessive Wait Time
alerts.description: Guests have been waiting in the entry area for an unacceptable duration. Risk of walkaway and negative reviews.
alerts.trigger: Zone state = QUEUE AND duration > 10 minutes AND zone type = entry

alerts.name: Empty Zone During Rush
alerts.description: A dining zone is completely empty while other zones are at high occupancy and entry queue exists. Potential seating opportunity missed.
alerts.trigger: Zone state = EMPTY AND other zones occupancy > 70% AND queue present

alerts.name: Unusually Fast Table Turn
alerts.description: A table turned over significantly faster than average. May indicate guests left unhappy (incomplete meal, bad experience).
alerts.trigger: Table turn time < 15 minutes (ASSUMPTION: configurable threshold)

alerts.name: No Staff in Zone
alerts.description: No staff blob has been detected in a zone with occupied tables for an extended period. Zone may be understaffed.
alerts.trigger: Zone has occupied tables AND no staff blob detected > 10 minutes

alerts.name: Pass Pickup Delayed
alerts.description: Plated food has been at the kitchen pass for too long without server pickup. Food quality degrading.
alerts.trigger: Food detected at pass zone > 3 minutes with no server blob approaching

alerts.name: Kitchen Overload Signal
alerts.description: Kitchen staff has signaled overload. Floor should slow seating and prioritize pickup of ready orders.
alerts.trigger: Kitchen overload button pressed OR pass zone congestion detected

alerts.name: Post-Bill Table Lingering
alerts.description: Table appears to have finished (bill paid or idle post-dessert) but guests are still seated. During rush, this blocks turnover.
alerts.trigger: Zone state = IDLE AND duration > 15 minutes AND occupancy > 70%

alerts.name: Multiple Zones Unattended
alerts.description: Two or more dining zones have no staff presence simultaneously. Systemic understaffing.
alerts.trigger: >=2 dining zones with no staff blob > 5 minutes simultaneously

alerts.name: Entry Area Unattended
alerts.description: Guests are in the entry area but no host/captain is present to seat them.
alerts.trigger: Entry zone has standing blobs > 1 minute AND no staff blob in entry zone

alerts.name: Camera Offline
alerts.description: CCTV camera feed has stopped. Zone covered by this camera loses detection capability.
alerts.trigger: No frames received from camera for > 30 seconds

alerts.name: Edge Device High Load
alerts.description: Edge device CPU or memory usage is above safe threshold. May affect detection performance.
alerts.trigger: CPU > 90% sustained for 5 minutes OR memory > 85%

alerts.name: Shift Started — No Staff Online
alerts.description: Service hours have started but no staff devices are connected. System cannot route alerts.
alerts.trigger: Service hour start AND zero connected staff devices for > 5 minutes

alerts.name: High Override Rate
alerts.description: Many alerts are being overridden as invalid. Indicates rules may need recalibration or a false-positive problem.
alerts.trigger: Override rate > 30% in the last 1 hour (>5 overrides out of last 15+ alerts)
